payload.title: plan skill: split-on-factors law against one-shard-per-unit
payload.body: In skills/plan/skill.ts, effort(unit) > capacity ⇒ split on factors(denotes(realizes(unit))) says each part realizes a factor, while realizes(unit) = the anchor of ONE shard and the loop says each unit realizes exactly one shard. A cold read (opus) flagged the tension: a factor-part does not realize a shard's anchor. Worth one ruling on what a split part realizes.
